caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden cradle or box with high side panels, slightly shorter end panels, and four vertical supporting posts at each corner. Each of the corner posts is rounded at the top, with simple carved detail, and the two longer side panels show some visible wood grain and knots, indicating the texture of the wood. The bottom edges of the end panels are attached to a pair of curved rockers that serve as the cradle’s base, allowing it to rock back and forth. The composition is rendered in sepia tones on a plain, light-colored background, giving the object a monochromatic brown appearance with darker shading and lines for texture and depth. The cradle is centered in the image with ample empty space surrounding it, and the drawing style is highly detailed and realistic.
title: Box Cradle
